name: GetSurfacePairFriction
evidence: for a pair of surface kinds, the sum of their values over the sum of their weights in g_surfaceFriction, at least 0, scaled by 0.2 with flag 8 of g_buttonCodeFlags (func_00185D20 reads it)

name: GetSurfacePairBounce
evidence: for a pair of surface kinds, the sum of their values over the sum of their weights in g_surfaceBounce, clamped to 0..1 (func_00185D20 reads it)

name: CreatePooledContact
evidence: takes a zeroed contact from the world's pool (+0x1AFC, PopZeroedFreeSlot), fills its two ends with the two objects and their surface kinds (+0x2C8), the point, the normal times the depth, the pair's friction and bounce (GetSurfacePairFriction, GetSurfacePairBounce), and runs func_001860A8 on it

name: FreePooledContactChain
evidence: walks a Contact03 chain returning each node to the pool at world+0x1AFC with PushFreeSlot

name: MeasurePointToLine
evidence: for a point and the line through two points writes the parameter of the point's projection (dot product over the squared length; 0 for points closer than 1e-4) and the distance from the point to it

name: MeasurePointToSegment
evidence: MeasurePointToLine with the parameter clamped to 0..1, so the distance is to the nearest point of the segment (MeasurePathCurveDistance, UpdatePlayer)

name: CollectEdgeContacts
evidence: tests each of the collider's edges (pairs of indexes into its points) against the context with func_0013DFD8, appending the hits to the output and pointing each at its edge; returns their count (func_00186BA8 calls it)

name: GroupEdgesByKey
evidence: sorts edges by the key their idx58 pair gives, swapping an edge's two halves when needed, and chains edges of the same key into groups

name: FindGraphPath
evidence: breadth-first search over groups whose pair holds two ids, from key to target, marking visited items with flag 4; returns the groups along the path in out

name: CollectMeshHits
evidence: under a back-memory scope tests a shape against a mesh's parts (func_0013E430, func_0013DFD8) and writes up to a maximum of hit records (point, normal, depth, part), returning their count; AddMeshContacts and the notifiers' probes call it

name: AddMeshContacts
evidence: collects up to 64 hits of a shape against a mesh (func_00187260, with the collider's +0x3A4) and creates a contact for each (CreatePooledContact), last first; CollidePlayerWithObject and CollideAgentWithObject call it
